editor.fichas.ayuda: Click a tile to change it (Enter applies, Esc cancels, Delete removes it). Click a + to insert. Drag a tile onto a + to move it. Ctrl+Z undoes.
editor.paleta.ayuda: A click puts it at the end of the DNA or at the last + you touched. Drag it onto a + to put it there.
editor.guardar.sinCambios: The text has not changed since the last version: no new one was saved.
editor.borrador.restaurado: You have unsaved changes from last time: they were restored.
editor.borrador.otraBase: You have unsaved changes written over another version of this bot.
editor.duplicar.soloLectura: Forum bots are read-only: to change this one, duplicate it as your own bot.
editor.duplicar.confirmarForo: That is the name of a forum bot: you can use it anyway, but they will be confused in the lists.
editor.error.nombre-repetido: You already have a bot called “{nombre}”.
editor.error.nombre-del-foro: “{nombre}” is the name of a forum bot.
editor.error.no-es-propio: This is a forum bot: edit it by duplicating it.
editor.lint.noDisponible: The DNA check is not available ({detalle}): the engine did not load.
editor.lint.nombre-direccion: {token} is not a sysvar: the engine reads it as 0. Did you mean address {sugerencia}? Addresses go without a dot.
editor.lint.nombre-parecido: {token} is not a sysvar: the engine reads it as 0. Did you mean {sugerencia}?
editor.lint.nombre-def-abajo: {token} is defined further down: the engine reads the DNA in order and here it is 0. Move the def up.
editor.lint.nombre-mayusculas: {token} does not match its def: private variables are case-sensitive and here it is 0.
editor.lint.nombre-desconocido: {token} is not a sysvar and has no def: the engine reads it as 0.
editor.lint.palabra-invisible-comando: {token} has an invisible character: it is not recognized as {sugerencia} and is 0.
editor.lint.palabra-invisible: {token} has invisible or encoding characters: it is 0.
editor.lint.palabra-parecida: {token} is not a command or a number: it is 0. Did you mean {sugerencia}?
editor.lint.palabra-desconocida: {token} is not a command or a number: it is 0 (text without the ' comment mark?).
editor.lint.primero: With defs, the first word ({token}) is not flow control and is lost.
editor.lint.sombra: The private variable {nombre} hides the sysvar .{nombre} in the whole bot.
editor.lint.defpegado: Every line that starts with “def” is a definition: {token} defines the variable {nombre}. If it is text, add the comment mark '.
editor.lint.defvalor: The value of a def must be a number: in def {nombre}, “{valor}” reads as 0.
editor.lint.error: The engine rejects this DNA (error {codigo}: a number outside ±32767 or a malformed def).
editor.lint.otro: {token}: the engine reads it differently than it looks.
editor.genes.vacio: The DNA has no genes yet.
editor.lab.autonomosAyuda: No own memory: they transplant with no dependencies or address collisions.
editor.lab.ayuda: Use + to add a gene at the end of the DNA. Each gene remembers which bot it came from.
editor.lab.errorCarga: Could not read the Bestiary genes: {detalle}
editor.lab.aviso.dep: Gene {gen} (from {bot}) reads address {dir}, which in its bot is written by gene {escritores}.
editor.lab.aviso.col: Address {dir} is used by {bots} for different things: remapping moves the later ones to free addresses (971-990 first).
editor.lab.aviso.gl: Gene {gen} (from {bot}) uses literal gene numbers in .delgene/.mkvirus that no longer point to the genes of its bot.
editor.lab.aviso.sin-repro: No gene reproduces: the bot will leave no offspring.
editor.lab.aviso.sin-energia: No gene gets energy (neither hunting nor photosynthesis).
editor.probar.contra: Compared with {version} using the same seeds.
editor.probar.sinAnterior: No previous version to compare with.
editor.probar.ultima: Last test · {base} · {semillas} seeds · {ciclos} cycles · not drawn
editor.probar.hijosAyuda: Direct offspring of each founding copy, on average (grandchildren excluded).
editor.probar.error.alga: Could not read the alga DNA.
editor.evolucion.ayuda: Generates variants of your DNA with the engine's mutations and tests them with the same seeds as the base. “Adopt” brings only the changed genes into the text, without saving a version.
editor.evolucion.sinVariantes: The engine produced no distinct variants; raise the intensity.
editor.evolucion.errorAdn: The engine could not read the DNA: there are no variants to test.
editor.evolucion.ultima: Last round · seed {semilla} · intensity {factor} · no drawing
editor.evolucion.desdeVariante: Base: variant {n} from the previous round.
editor.evolucion.error.textos: The variant texts are not valid.
editor.evolucion.error.sinVariantes: There are no variants to test.
editor.versiones.restaurarAyuda: Saves v{n} as a new version (nothing is lost)
editor.versiones.yaActual: That version is already the current one.
editor.versiones.confirmarRestaurar: You have unsaved changes: restoring v{n} replaces them (in text mode, Undo brings them back).
editor.pila.ejemploAyuda: These are the values the sysvars read by the gene would have. Change them to see how the condition changes. They are kept in this browser, for this bot.
editor.pila.noCorre: does not run with these values
editor.pila.sinGen: The cursor is not inside a gene: move it into one to see its stack.
editor.pila.sinDatos: The DNA does not load or the trace does not match the text.
editor.pila.semillaFija: rnd uses a fixed seed (1234): in this view, rnd always gives the same value.
